family: The total norm-one language defined in family.md. Reject lengths below 16 and invalid irreducibility headers. In the field E defined by the headers at actual length N, accept precisely when the payload z raised to the sum of 2^(mj) over 0<=j<t equals one. Ignore the tail. The verifier uses an empty witness.
theorem: For every sufficiently large integer input length N, every single-output full-B2 circuit computing this fixed language has at least (1223949/250000)N gates, with unrestricted sharing and repeated pins.
